import java.util.Scanner;

public class Main {
    public static void main(String[] args) {
        Scanner sc = new Scanner(System.in);
        String s1 = sc.next();
        int pos = s1.indexOf("at", 1);
        String s2;
        if (pos == -1) {
            s2 = s1 + '@' + s1.substring(1);
        } else {
            s2 = s1.substring(0, pos) + '@' + s1.substring(pos + 2);
        }
        int i = s2.indexOf("dot", 1);
        int last = 0;
        StringBuilder ans = new StringBuilder();
        while (i != -1 && i < s2.length() - 3) {
            ans.append(s2.substring(last, i));
            ans.append(".");
            last = i + 3;
            i = s2.indexOf("dot", last);
        }
        ans.append(s2.substring(last));
        System.out.println(ans.toString());
    }
}
